method: 12 segments drawn from the 40,888 included untagged-service segments, weighted by length so the sample represents km rather than count; numpy default_rng seed 20260825. Reviewed on Esri World Imagery at z19.

categories.street_like: the only vehicle access to dwellings along it — a camera car would treat it as a street
categories.yard: industrial, agricultural or commercial service and loading area

caveat: n=12. This is an indication of the split, NOT a measurement: the standard error on a one-third proportion at n=12 is about 14 percentage points. A defensible estimate needs on the order of 100 samples.
